Hi Elena — thanks for the packet and context. A few items and next steps from procurement/finance so we can move toward PO issuance: 

Checklist (what we need to clear):
- Completed and signed W-8BEN-E with UBO section filled (we can accept a scanned signature). Please confirm page 3 includes the legal entity name exactly as on formation docs.
- EIN confirmation acceptable: we typically require either the vendor's official EIN letter or Form 147-C (IRS notice). If the EIN belongs to a fiscal agent, we need a short explanation and a copy of the contract/power-of-attorney showing the agent relationship.
- If there is a name mismatch between bank letter and W-8, please provide either a company formation cert or a notarized letter explaining the relationship.

Possible temporary path: Procurement can issue a conditional PO (up to $10k) while final docs are collected; to do that we need an explicit request and acceptance of conditional terms.

Next steps:
1) Could you upload the signed W-8BEN-E v2 to our vendor portal or reply with the signed PDF? (DocuSign link also works: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-UMBRA)
2) If the fiscal agent EIN will remain separate, please attach the agent agreement or a signed statement explaining billing/collection flows.
3) Confirm desired billing address and bank details for the PO/ACH.

I'll loop Finance (Naomi) on the EIN mismatch question and Marissa on the PO timing. If you can get the signed W-8 back this morning, I can push for a conditional PO same day.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending the signed W-8 and the agent agreement. A few finance items to confirm so we can finalize a temporary PO: 

1) EIN verification: the agent agreement helps. For final PO release and vendor file completion we will still need either:
   - The vendor's official EIN confirmation (local government letter) or
   - IRS-style proof (Form 147-C) or
   - A notarized attestation that ties the registrant name to the fiscal agent (if the local doc cannot be provided quickly).

2) Conditional PO: Procurement can issue a conditional PO up to $10,000 while you supply the final EIN proof. To proceed we need an acceptance email acknowledging the conditional nature and payment hold terms. If you confirm, we will prepare the PO (Umbra_PO_Temp_UpTo10k.pdf attached).

3) Banking / ACH details: please confirm the company name for ACH (legal name exactly as on W-8) and a copy of a voided check or bank letter showing account number. If the fiscal agent is receiving funds on your behalf, include the payment routing instructions and agent agreement clause authorizing pass-through.

If you can confirm acceptance of the conditional PO and provide either the local EIN letter or a notarized attestation by EOD today, we will issue the temporary PO and policy note to our payments team to allow the pilot to start Monday.

Best regards,
Naomi Feldman
Vendor Onboarding Specialist, Redwood Inference
Procurement & Finance
